we propose a new architecture for mobile and embedded applications that uses depth wise convolutions to build efficient models and we introduce two hyper parameters that can be used to efficiently trade off between accuracy and latency.
MobileNets can be used for many different computer vision tasks.

MobileNets: 1) provide a new class of models that are light weight and fast while still achieving high accuracy; 2) are designed to be used in mobile and embedded applications; 3) are easy to use, with two simple hyper parameters that can be tuned to control accuracy versus latency.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing efficient models that can run in real time on mobile devices and that can scale up to the large labeled datasets required for deep learning based vision systems.
developing efficient models that can be run on mobile devices with limited compute and memory resources.
the design of efficient deep neural networks for mobile applications.

MobileNets are a new efficient architecture based on depthwise separable convolutions.
MobileNets are a class of light weight deep learning models for mobile vision applications.
MobileNets are a new family of light weight deep neural network architectures for mobile and embedded applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
MobileNets are a class of small, fast to learn, and power efficient models for mobile and embedded use.
MobileNets can be used to build large scale mobile vision systems that are both fast and accurate.
